description: This file provides testing utilities for the Prometheus client_golang library, including functions to extract metric values, count metrics, compare scraped metrics, and format metrics for testing purposes.

methods.name: ToFloat64
methods.description: Collects metrics from a Collector, expecting exactly one metric, and returns its float value. Panics if the collection does not yield exactly one metric or if the metric is not gauge, counter, or untyped.

methods.name: CollectAndCount
methods.description: Registers a Collector with a new pedantic registry and counts the number of metrics with specified names, panicking on failure.

methods.name: GatherAndCount
methods.description: Gathers metrics from a Gatherer and counts the total number of metric children, optionally filtering by metric names.

methods.name: ScrapeAndCompare
methods.description: Scrapes metrics from a URL and compares them to expected metrics, optionally filtering by metric names.

methods.name: CollectAndCompare
methods.description: Collects metrics from a Collector and compares them to expected metrics in text format, optionally filtering by metric names.

methods.name: GatherAndCompare
methods.description: Gathers metrics from a Gatherer and compares to expected metrics in text format, optionally filtering by metric names.

methods.name: TransactionalGatherAndCompare
methods.description: Gathers metrics transactionally from a Gatherer and compares to expected metrics, optionally filtering by metric names.

methods.name: CollectAndFormat
methods.description: Collects metrics from a Collector and returns them in a specified format, optionally filtering by metric names.
